list.name: provider
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs ORDER BY provider

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND provider IN ($provider)
SELECT sum(completion_tokens) FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND provider IN ($provider)
SELECT 1000 * sum(cost_usd) / clamp_min(sum(total_tokens), 1) FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND provider IN ($provider)
SELECT uniqExact(conversation_id) FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND provider IN ($provider)
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS t, provider, sum(cost_usd) AS cost FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND provider IN ($provider) GROUP BY t, provider ORDER BY t

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS t, sum(prompt_tokens) AS prompt, sum(completion_tokens) AS completion FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND provider IN ($provider) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT conversation_id, sum(cost_usd) AS spend, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, count() AS calls FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND provider IN ($provider) GROUP BY conversation_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT model, sum(cost_usd) AS cost FROM ollivelogs.inference_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND provider IN ($provider) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 15
